# Data export {.unnumbered #data-export}

## CSV downloads {#csv-downloads}

Response panels provide CSV downloads containing the RF frequency axis and the calculated Amplitude, In phase, and Quadrature values. Optical exports also identify the signal and readout mode.

Downloads contain the numerical values before any visual interpolation. Units and applied display factors are recorded in the export where supported.

## Reproducible records {#reproducible-records}

For an experimental comparison, retain together:

- the condition JSON file;
- the relevant CSV exports;
- the application version;
- the physics-model identifier;
- notes describing experimental power, beam diameter, cell geometry, and calibration.

The condition file stores intensity in µW/cm², not optical power and beam diameter separately. Any conversion from measured power to local beam intensity must therefore be documented outside the condition file.

## Plot sign controls {#export-and-sign-controls}

The **Add (pi)** display controls change the plotted sign of In phase or Quadrature. When comparing CSV data with a plotted curve, consult the export columns that distinguish raw and plotted values.
